theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_sl_sf_unit_orient
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (ξ : MultiVector P n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ α| ≤ ‖α‖) ∧ ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ξ : MultiVector P (n + 1)) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (v : Euclid P) (ζ : MultiVector P n), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → v ∈ Q → v ≠ 0 → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ζ α = ξ (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (‖v‖⁻¹ • v)).smulRight α))) → IsUnitOrientationOf ζ (Q ⊓ (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ)
